deviations_from_card: Per the critic's revision, Transport.run still yields str only: the exit crosses as an ExitHandle carried on each CliRequest (compare=False, starts at ExitStatus(0)), so src/athena/adopt/legs.py and both adopt fakes are untouched; a lines-only transport reads as exit 0 (pinned by an extra test). ExitStatus has no timed_out field: a timeout already crosses the port as TimeoutError and keeps its 'timeout' reason. SubprocessTransport drains stderr concurrently into a 4 KiB tail instead of reading it at exit (a full stderr pipe would block the child). tests/harness/test_rounds_failures.py needed no change (write set shrunk). The existing clean-exit test in test_cli_harness.py now scripts a result record, since a stream with none is now 'stopped before it finished'; a new test pins that. All classes keep ledger reason engine_error (no contract change). ADR is 0109 (0107/0108 were taken by siblings).
notes: Red-before measured twice: on base the new file fails at import (all 8 red, API absent); on the transport seam alone (commit be009b4, harness unchanged) cases 1-6 are red by behaviour and guards 7-8 (indexes 6,7) pass. Whole-tree gates were red only on sibling paths: ruff check on tests/connectors/test_health.py (E501), ruff format on 2 sibling files, mypy on src/athena/channels/voice/gateway.py:819, and the full pytest had 4 voice failures (test_voice_engines, test_voice_gateway, daemon/test_voice_routes) that passed on the 60 s rerun. The full pytest otherwise had no failures. The shared scratchpad is used by siblings too: my ADR draft there was deleted mid-run (rewritten directly into docs/adr).
